claim: Paper Figure 4a visually favors DU-Net over Linear UCB.
Local reward-weighted w-RMSE recovers the paper direction, but not the paper scale.
Full-test conventional RMSE favors Linear UCB, so this is not an exact Figure 4a reproduction.
High-rating test regions favor DU-Net, supporting the reward-region mechanism.
Low-rating test regions favor Linear UCB, explaining the full-test RMSE reversal.
Paper-like sigmoid weighting is effectively tied at 20 seeds.
